Task:
With `HandleMethodNotAllowed` enabled and several method trees containing wildcard alternatives, a missing path can panic in radix-tree lookup because skipped-node backtracking entries accumulate across successive method-tree searches. Make each `getValue` lookup start with an empty skipped-node stack while retaining the pooled allocation. Preserve correct 404 behavior for an unmatched path and 405 behavior, including the `Allow` header, when another method is registered. Add focused stress coverage across many method trees.

Phase 1 only: add the smallest focused regression that reproduces the reported defect, and edit no file outside the allowed regression path. Name the focused regression with the prefix `TestIssue4818_`. Reproduce the fixed-method-tree failure with OPTIONS and GET on `/:p0/:p1/a/:p2`; PATCH on `/b/:p0/:p1/c`; DELETE on `/b/:p0/:p1/d/:p3`; GET on `/b/:p0/:p1/e/f`; POST and OPTIONS on `/b/:p0/:p1/g/:p4/h`; DELETE on `/b/cache`; GET and POST on `/b/clients/:p1/g`; and PATCH and OPTIONS on `/b/clients/:p1/g/:p4`. Assert that POST `/b/clients/42` does not panic and returns 404. Inspect the unchanged production source deeply enough to diagnose the defect, but stop before changing production code or implementing the fix. Run the required focused check once after adding the regression; failure that demonstrates the defect is expected. In the final seven-line diagnosis, cite the regression and at least one unchanged production source anchor as repository-relative `path:start-end` ranges.
